news_items.headline: ALAB Stock Climbs As RBC Hikes AI-Driven Price Target to $250
news_items.summary: RBC reiterated Outperform and raised PT from $225 to $250, citing Amazon's expanded Anthropic deal funneling demand to ALAB; RBC expects Scorpio X switches to ramp in Trainium3 racks starting Q3.

news_items.headline: Astera Labs Inc Stock (ALAB) Moved Up by 12.58% on May 19
news_items.summary: ALAB surged 13.14% on May 19 after AI connectivity demand commentary and analyst PT hikes, significantly outperforming the tech sector's 0.87% decline.

news_items.headline: Astera Labs (ALAB) Jumps As RBC Hikes $250 Price Target
news_items.summary: RBC's bullish thesis centers on Amazon-Anthropic expanded deal driving Scorpio X switch demand for Trainium3 racks in H2 2026.

news_items.headline: Why Is Astera Labs (ALAB) Stock Trending Overnight?

news_items.headline: Astera Labs stock jumps 16%: is AI inference the next big catalyst?

news_items.headline: Does Astera Labs' Earnings Beat, AI Switch Launch And ESOP Shelf Change The Bull Case For ALAB?
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 beat plus launch of Scorpio X-Series 320-lane Smart Fabric Switch and expanded Scorpio P-Series PCIe-6 (32-320 lane configs); multi-customer shipments expected H2 2026.

news_items.headline: Should Investors Buy, Hold, or Sell ALAB Stock Post Q1 Earnings?
news_items.summary: Post Q1 earnings analysis weighing the bull case (AI fabric demand, Scorpio ramp) against valuation considerations.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: RBC raised PT to $250 from $225 (Outperform reiterated, 2026-05-19). Evercore ISI maintained Outperform with PT raised to $297. Current month breakdown: 16 Buy / 7 Hold / 0 Sell across 19 analysts.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported (early May) with beat on revenue ($308M) and EPS, plus stronger Q2 guide. Next earnings expected late July / early August 2026. Street expects continued AI-driven revenue ramp; Scorpio X switch ramp in Trainium3 racks (Q3) is the near-term key catalyst, with multi-customer shipments H2 2026 and broader volume in 2027.
